user.title: Light Buddy
user.description: Creates one light for every area that contains lights, e.g. `light.all_living`. Lights belong to their own area, or to their device's area.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Light Buddy is already set up. Use the options to exclude areas or lights.

data_description.excluded_areas: No room light is created for these areas.
data_description.excluded_lights: These lights are never part of a room light, e.g. template lights that control other lights.

settings.title: Settings

data_description.warmest: At night, in the early morning, and from 1:30 after sunset (at the latest 22:00).
data_description.coldest: From about two hours after sunrise (not before 08:00, not after 09:00) until solar noon.
data_description.threshold: Lights that are on only get a new color temperature once the target differs at least this much.
data_description.transition: For the schedule's updates every minute. Keep it short: IKEA lights ignore other commands, even turning off, during a transition.
data_description.auto_resume_minutes: After a manual change, the room's Schedule switch turns on again by itself after this time. 0 waits until the room is off.
data_description.separate_commands: Some lights, IKEA ones in particular, do not change brightness and color temperature together cleanly, e.g. when turning on a room with a brightness. They then get the color temperature first and the brightness half a second later.
data_description.disco_interval: Seconds until the next color. Each color change sends one command per color, so very short times load the Zigbee network.
data_description.disco_palette: The colors the disco mode cycles through. Each light shows a different one.

settings.description:
![Curve]({chart})

The schedule follows the sun: warmest from late evening until sunrise (not before 06:00, not after 07:30), coldest from about two hours after sunrise until solar noon. The chart shows the saved values for today, and thin lines for the longest and shortest day.

error.schedule_span: The coldest value has to be at least 500 K above the warmest.

no_color_lights.message: No light in this room supports colors.
